# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe what changed and why it is needed.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Game-definition or configuration update
- [ ] User-interface improvement
- [ ] Security or privacy improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Other maintenance

## Validation

- [ ] I built the solution successfully.
- [ ] I ran the relevant automated tests.
- [ ] I manually checked the affected workflow where practical.
- [ ] I did not include passwords, tokens, webhooks, public IP addresses, private paths, or user server data.
- [ ] I did not include `bin`, `obj`, publish output, server files, generated installers, or other build artifacts.
- [ ] I kept the change focused and explained any behavior that could affect existing Synix users.

## Game-server changes

If this changes a game definition, arguments, configuration, or installation behavior, include the authoritative source used and identify which operations were verified.

**Source:**

**Verified operations:**

- [ ] Install
- [ ] Start
- [ ] Stop
- [ ] Monitoring
- [ ] Arguments
- [ ] Configuration
- [ ] Not applicable

## License acknowledgement

- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution and understand that accepted contributions are governed by the contribution terms in `LICENSE.md`.
